recentItems.title: [GRAPHIC CONTENT] Kempton Park body identified as missing Itumeleng Kekana
recentItems.description:
32-year-old Itumeleng Kekana from Mmakwane Village at QwaQwa in the Free State is among eight women whose bodies were discovered between the Kempton Park, Olifantsfontein and Springs areas.

Kekana went missing on 17 July, prompting a search by her family.

For more we cross to our reporter Abigail Visagie. 

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: NPA wants charges against Masemola dropped
recentItems.description:
The National Director of Public Prosecution, Adv Andy Mothibi has formally issued instructions that charges be withdrawn against National Police Commissioner General Fannie Masemola. 

Mothibi is satisfied that there are no reasonable prospects of a successful prosecution against the National Commissioner on Finance Management Act charges.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Zanzibar prepares for El Niño rains
recentItems.description:
Zanzibar authorities are stepping up preparations for the El Niño-affected October-to-December rainy season, urging people in high-risk areas to take action before heavy rains arrive.

The Tanzania Meteorological Authority says the short rainy season is expected to bring normal to above-normal rainfall in several parts of the country, with rains beginning from late September and potentially extending into January.

recentItems.title: All systems go for AAD Expo 2026
recentItems.description:
President Cyril Ramaphosa will open the AAD Exhibition and Airshow in Pretoria. 

The biennial event brings together defence and aerospace industry leaders, government officials, and exhibitors from South Africa and around the world. 

The exhibition showcases the latest developments in aerospace, defence technology and security, while also providing a platform for business opportunities and industry partnerships.

For more on this we cross live to our reporter Patricia Visagie.

recentItems.title: 'Cat’ Matlala and co-accused back in court
recentItems.description:
Alleged gunman in the trial of Vusimuzi Matlala and others, Musa Kekana, is expected to continue with his testimony in the trial-within-a-trial. 

Kekana is on trial with Matlala, Tsakani Matlala, Tiego Mabusela and Nthabiseng Nzama on charges of attempted murder and conspiracy to commit murder.

This relates to the botched assassinations of socialite Tebogo Thobejane, businessman Joe Sibanyoni and music producer Seunkie Mokubung.

Kekana is currently objecting to the state using some of the evidence police obtained during his arrest in 2024.

He has alleged that police assaulted him on the day.

Lets cross live to SABC News Reporter, Neria Hlakotsa

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Matlala Trial | Kekana’s bid to have arrest evidence declared inadmissible continues
recentItems.description:
Alleged hit-man Musa Kekana is expected to resume with his cross-examination today in the trial of Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala and four others, at the High Court in Johannesburg.

 Matlala and his co-accused illegedly orchestrated three failed assassination attempts targeting his former girlfriend, Tebogo Thobejane, taxi boss Joe 'Ferari' Sibanyoni and music producer Seunkie Mokubung, popularly known as DJ Vettys.  

We now cross to SABC News reporter Neria Hlakotsa has the latest update.
